mn32:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Gosiṅgasālavanadāye viharati sambahulehi abhiññātehi abhiññātehi therehi sāvakehi saddhiṃ,

mn32:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yen' āyasmā Mahākassapo ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahākassapaṃ etadavoca:
mn32:2.2: Āyām' āvuso Kassapa yen' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkamissāma dhammasavanāyāti.
mn32:2.3: Evam-āvuso ti kho āyasmā Mahākassapo āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa paccassosi.
mn32:2.4: Atha kho āyasmā ca Mahāmoggallāno āyasmā ca Mahākassapo āyasmā ca Anuruddho yen' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu dhammasavanāya.
mn32:3.1: Addasā kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmantañ-ca Mahāmoggallānaṃ āyasmantañ-ca Mahākassapaṃ āyasmantañ-ca Anuruddhaṃ yen' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkamante dhammasavanāya,
mn32:3.2: disvāna yen' āyasmā Revato ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Revataṃ etad-avoca:
mn32:3.3: Upasaṅkamantā kho amū āvuso Revata sappurisā yen' āyasmā Sāriputto tena dhammasavanāya,
mn32:3.4: āyām' āvuso Revata yen' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkamissāma dhammasavanāyāti.
mn32:3.5: Evam-āvuso ti kho āyasmā Revato āyasmato Ānandassa paccassosi.
mn32:3.6: Atha kho āyasmā ca Revato āyasmā ca Ānando yen' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu dhammasavanāya.
mn32:4.1: Addasā kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantañ-ca Revataṃ āyasmantañ-ca Ānandaṃ dūrato va āgacchante,
mn32:4.4: sāgataṃ āyasmato Ānandassa Bhagavato upaṭṭhākassa Bhagavato santikāvacarassa.
mn32:4.5: Ramaṇīyaṃ āvuso Ānanda Gosiṅgasālavanaṃ, dosinā ratti, sabbaphāliphullā sālā, dibbā maññe gandhā sampavanti.
mn32:4.6: Kathaṃrūpena āvuso Ānanda bhikkhunā Gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyāti. --
mn32:4.7: Idh' āvuso Sāriputta bhikkhu bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā sabyañjanā kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti tathārūpā 'ssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā, vacasā paricitā, manasā 'nupekkhitā, diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā;

mn32:4.9: Evarūpena kho āvuso Sāriputta bhikkhunā Gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyāti.

mn32:17.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn32:17.4: Api ca mama pi suṇātha yathārūpena bhikkhunā Gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyya.
